SystemCodeDisplay (en)DefinitionJSONXML
https://YasniiSS.github.io/fhir4eyes/CodeSystem/fhir4eyes-cs  fusionFusionSensory fusion: the images of both eyes are combined into a single percept (e.g. a single pinkish light on the red filter plus light test, four lights on the Worth 4 dot test). SNOMED CT 78513008 Fusion binocular vision is an observable entity, not a finding, so it is not used as an answer.
https://YasniiSS.github.io/fhir4eyes/CodeSystem/fhir4eyes-cs  corneal-reflex-centeredCorneal light reflex centeredOn corneal light reflex (Hirschberg) testing, the reflex is centered on the pupil of the eye assessed, consistent with no manifest deviation of that eye.
https://YasniiSS.github.io/fhir4eyes/CodeSystem/fhir4eyes-cs  corneal-reflex-displaced-nasalCorneal light reflex displaced nasallyOn corneal light reflex (Hirschberg) testing, the reflex in the eye assessed is displaced nasally from the pupil centre, indicating an exodeviation of that eye.
https://YasniiSS.github.io/fhir4eyes/CodeSystem/fhir4eyes-cs  corneal-reflex-displaced-temporalCorneal light reflex displaced temporallyOn corneal light reflex (Hirschberg) testing, the reflex in the eye assessed is displaced temporally from the pupil centre, indicating an esodeviation of that eye.
https://YasniiSS.github.io/fhir4eyes/CodeSystem/fhir4eyes-cs  corneal-reflex-displaced-superiorCorneal light reflex displaced superiorlyOn corneal light reflex (Hirschberg) testing, the reflex in the eye assessed is displaced superiorly from the pupil centre, indicating a hypodeviation of that eye.
https://YasniiSS.github.io/fhir4eyes/CodeSystem/fhir4eyes-cs  corneal-reflex-displaced-inferiorCorneal light reflex displaced inferiorlyOn corneal light reflex (Hirschberg) testing, the reflex in the eye assessed is displaced inferiorly from the pupil centre, indicating a hyperdeviation of that eye.
